card.name: Word after quantifier, before hyphen compound
card.fires_on: The word or hyphen right after a quantifier like all, first, one, several or top, where a compound or noun is about to continue. Most often the hyphen in "all-cause".

modes.description: A hyphen or hyphen-led piece after first, one or top that starts a compound modifier.
modes.example: The representatives of the Quebec people are elected with the first<<-p>>ast-the-post electoral method.

modes.label: Word after several or little
modes.description: A plain adjective or verb right after a quantity word in general prose.
modes.example: Estimates of dinosaur speeds vary because several<< different>> methods are used to calculate them.
